summary.text: Jessica Bateman is a Democratic state senator for the 22nd Legislative District, based in Olympia. Her official biography says she chairs the Senate Housing Committee and previously served in the state House of Representatives and on the Olympia City Council.

paragraphs.text: Bateman is a lifelong resident of the Pacific Northwest who grew up in a single-parent, working-class household, according to her official biography.

The page says she is a first-generation college student who earned a master's degree in public administration from The Evergreen State College, a bachelor's degree in environmental studies and an associate degree from Green River Community College, and that she paid her way through school working in customer service and as a housekeeper.
The biography says she sponsored the 2023 "middle housing" legislation, HB 1110, and has been nationally recognized for leadership on housing affordability as chair of the Senate Housing Committee.

It also says she has sponsored legislation eliminating copays for abortion care, ensuring access to mifepristone and increasing the behavioral health workforce, and that outside the Legislature she works as a health care strategic advisor.
